title: Show retry overlay before Chrome's iframe timeout error renders
description: On slow Sigma cold starts, Chrome's native 'app.sigmacomputing.com took too long to respond' page renders inside the iframe at ~30s. We can't detect or hide it cross-origin once it appears. Fix: track iframe onLoad event, and if it hasn't fired after a configurable timeout (e.g. 25s), show our own overlay over the iframe with a retry button. Retry should bump refreshKey to force a fresh JWT fetch and iframe reload.

title: Stale JWT reused when navigating back to Internal User embed
description: The first embed uses initialEmbedData passed from the server-rendered dashboard page. When the user navigates to the second embed and back, the SigmaEmbed component remounts and reuses the same server-rendered initialEmbedUrl, so the JWT never refreshes after the initial page load. Eventually that initial JWT expires, breaking the embed. Fix: only use initialEmbedData on the very first dashboard render; once the user navigates away, subsequent visits should fetch a fresh JWT client-side.

title: Add Clerk metadata field for per-user URL filter params on Secured embed
description: Currently Clerk publicMetadata.userAttributes goes into the JWT user_attributes claim (used by Sigma for RLS). We need a separate metadata field for params that get appended to the embed URL itself — e.g. workbook parameters or filter overrides — rather than going into the JWT. Scope per mode so only the relevant page applies them. Show the applied URL params in the JWT inspector for demo clarity.

title: Allow setting JWT session length from inspector for stale-token demos
description: Add a control in the JWT inspector that lets the user override the session length (exp claim) at runtime. Currently SESSION_LENGTH is fixed via env var. Need to: 1) accept sessionLength as a query param on /api/sigma/jwt and forward it to generateSigmaEmbedUrl, 2) allow generateSigmaEmbedUrl to accept a sessionLength override, 3) lift session length to DashboardShell state, pass down to SigmaEmbed which triggers a refetch when changed, 4) add input + preset buttons in JwtInspector (30s, 1m, 5m, default) and an 'Apply & regenerate' button.

title: Add a new embedded workbook page
description: Add a second navigation item to the dashboard for a new embedded Sigma workbook. Needs: nav label, env var (e.g. NEWPAGE_SIGMA_BASE_URL in .env.local + Vercel), nav item entry in components/DashboardShell.js with mode set to match the env var prefix, and an appropriate icon.

title: Rename 'Workbook Embed' nav item to 'Workbook - Internal User example'
description: Update the existing nav item label in components/DashboardShell.js so it reflects its purpose as an internal-user-style embed example. Both the NAV_ITEMS top-level label and the inner embeds[].label should be updated for consistency in breadcrumbs and the JWT inspector.
